description: REQUIRES prior nps_edi__auth__npki_session__login call with same account_link_id. This writes to the institution. The first call is not executed: it returns a preview of exactly what will be sent and a one-time confirmation_token (error WRITE_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED). Show that preview to the user as it is. Only after the user agrees, call again with the same arguments plus that confirmation_token. Never add the token without the user's agreement. Changing any argument makes the token invalid; call without the token to get a new preview. Send the NPS membership certificate application (form EB0301) for 1 to 100 subscribers. Do this before the issue tool: the issue screen lists subscribers only under a received application document number. IRREVERSIBLE: a sent application cannot be cancelled and stays in the institution's records. Each subscriber needs member_name and rrno (13-digit resident registration number; never echoed back - the preview shows names and the last 4 digits only). 호출마다 토큰 1소진 요청 처리 시 XBOSS 작업을 생성하고 처리 결과를 저장합니다. 기관 원본의 조회 여부와 별개로 이 호출은 순수 읽기 전용이 아닙니다. 기관 데이터 변경은 도구별 실행 내용과 기존 확인 절차를 따릅니다.

account_link_id.description: Account link ID (UUID v4). Optional — the server auto-resolves from your API key when omitted. Provide explicitly only when you have multiple certificates for the same provider. Each institution has a separate ID (Hometax != NHIS != NPS != FourInsure).

confirmation_token.description: One-time confirmation token returned by the first call (error WRITE_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED). Send it back unchanged with the same arguments to execute; it expires in 10 minutes and works once.

subscribers.description: 신청 대상자 목록(1명 이상 100명 이하). 대상자마다 성명과 주민등록번호를 넣는다

member_name.description: 대상자 성명. 기관이 확인한 성명과 다르면 신청서를 보내지 않는다

rrno.description: 대상자 주민등록번호(외국인등록번호) 13자리. 하이픈을 넣어도 된다. 응답과 증적에는 싣지 않는다
